name: Tourist / Entry Visa

requirements.blocker_text: An entry visa (single, multiple-entry, or collective) is issued by the competent Libyan authority with a specified expiry date. This dataset could not identify a single unified official e-visa portal -- Libya has had rival, competing administrations (Tripoli-based and eastern) since 2014, and consultancy/travel-agency sites describing an e-visa process do not agree on a single authoritative government domain, so this build relies on third-party visa-agency guides rather than a confirmed government source.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for an entry visa through the process described by the relevant consular authority or an accredited visa agency; requirements and portals reportedly vary depending on point of entry and which administration controls it.

evidence_required.document: Visa application per issuing authority's requirements

outcome.duration_length: approximately 30 days (reported by consultancy sources, not independently confirmed against a government tariff/validity schedule)

sources.title: DoVisa -- Libya e-Visa Guide 2026: application requirements (generic visa-agency guide, not a government source)
